questions.text: How many voyages sailed via the Cape of Good Hope?

questions.text: What was overall schedule reliability in each year?
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pc.scheduled_arrival), ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN pc.actual_arrival <= pc.scheduled_arrival + INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 4) FROM network.port_calls pc WHERE pc.seq > 1 AND pc.actual_arrival IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
questions.title: What was overall schedule reliability in each year

questions.text: Which five ports had the most container moves overall?
questions.sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(pc.container_moves) AS moves FROM network.port_calls pc JOIN network.ports p ON p.port_code = pc.port_code GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY moves DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
questions.title: Which five ports had the most container moves overall

questions.text: What is the average time in port per call at Rotterdam, in hours?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (actual_departure - actual_arrival)) / 3600)::numeric, 1) FROM network.port_calls WHERE port_code = 'NLRTM' AND actual_arrival IS NOT NULL
questions.title: What is the average time in port per call at Rotterdam, in hours

questions.text: How many customers are based in China?

questions.text: How many bookings were made in 2025, including cancelled ones?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commercial.bookings WHERE booking_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND booking_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
questions.title: How many bookings were made in 2025, including cancelled ones

questions.text: What was total TEU volume in 2025, excluding cancelled bookings?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(teu) FROM commercial.bookings WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND cargo_ready_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
questions.title: What was total TEU volume in 2025, excluding cancelled bookings

questions.text: What was ocean freight revenue by trade lane in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT s.lane_code, ROUND(SUM(b.freight_revenue_usd), 2) FROM commercial.bookings b JOIN network.services s ON s.service_code = b.service_code WHERE b.status <> 'cancelled' AND b.cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND b.cargo_ready_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.lane_code
questions.title: What was ocean freight revenue by trade lane in 2025

questions.text: What share of bookings were cancelled?

questions.title: What share of bookings were cancelled

questions.text: How many non-cancelled bookings with a 2024 cargo ready date were rolled at least once, by trade lane code?
questions.sql: SELECT s.lane_code, COUNT(*) FROM commercial.bookings b JOIN network.services s ON s.service_code = b.service_code WHERE b.rolled_count > 0 AND b.status <> 'cancelled' AND b.cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND b.cargo_ready_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY s.lane_code

questions.text: How much 2025 TEU was shipped under contract versus spot?
questions.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN contract_id IS NULL THEN 'spot' ELSE 'contract' END, SUM(teu) FROM commercial.bookings WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND cargo_ready_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1

questions.text: How many contracts started in 2026, by lane code?

questions.text: What was the total invoiced per charge code in 2025?

questions.text: How much did we spend on bunker fuel in 2025?

questions.text: Which port had the most delay incidents?
questions.sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM operations.delay_incidents d JOIN network.ports p ON p.port_code = d.port_code GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.text: How many EU ETS allowances were due for voyages departing in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(e.eu_ets_allowances), 1) FROM operations.voyage_emissions e JOIN network.voyages v ON v.voyage_id = e.voyage_id WHERE v.departure_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.departure_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
questions.title: How many EU ETS allowances were due for voyages departing in 2025

questions.text: What was average headhaul vessel utilisation by service in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT v.service_code, ROUND(AVG(e.teu_carried::numeric / vs.teu_capacity), 4) FROM operations.voyage_emissions e JOIN network.voyages v ON v.voyage_id = e.voyage_id JOIN network.vessels vs ON vs.vessel_id = v.vessel_id WHERE v.direction = 'headhaul' AND v.departure_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.departure_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY v.service_code
questions.title: What was average headhaul vessel utilisation by service in 2025

questions.text: How many pallets were in stock across all logistics centres on the latest snapshot?

questions.text: Chart voyages completed by service in 2025.
questions.sql: SELECT service_code, COUNT(*) AS voyages FROM network.voyages WHERE status = 'completed' AND departure_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND departure_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY service_code ORDER BY voyages DESC

questions.text: Chart the top 5 commodities by TEU in 2025.
questions.sql: SELECT commodity, SUM(teu) AS teu FROM commercial.bookings WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND cargo_ready_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND cargo_ready_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY commodity ORDER BY teu DESC LIMIT 5

questions.text: Chart containers by type.

questions.text: Chart invoices by status.

questions.text: Chart claims by type filed in 2025.
questions.sql: SELECT claim_type, COUNT(*) AS claims FROM finance.claims WHERE filed_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND filed_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY claim_type ORDER BY claims DESC

questions.text: Chart delay incidents by cause in 2024.
questions.sql: SELECT cause, COUNT(*) AS incidents FROM operations.delay_incidents WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01' AND started_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01' GROUP BY cause ORDER BY incidents DESC
questions.title: Delay incidents by cause, 2024

questions.text: Chart total fleet CO2 emissions per year.
questions.sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.departure_date) AS INT) AS year, ROUND(SUM(e.co2_tonnes), 1) AS co2_tonnes FROM operations.voyage_emissions e JOIN network.voyages v ON v.voyage_id = e.voyage_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
questions.title: Fleet CO2 emissions per year

questions.text: Chart the average trucking job cost by leg.
questions.sql: SELECT leg, ROUND(AVG(cost_usd), 2) AS avg_cost_usd FROM operations.trucking_jobs GROUP BY leg ORDER BY avg_cost_usd DESC
